target_customer: Brands paying for discounts in exchange for short video reviews; shoppers are the content creators
problem: Shoppers trust video reviews but brands lack a cheap supply of authentic review video; Cartcam paid reviewers with discounts.
business_model: Brand-funded discounts in exchange for user video review content

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile video capture and discount app with an order flow; standard engineering for 2017 with no hard research problem.

defensibility.rationale: Video review incentives were easy to copy and no data or network moat is documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows any incumbent reacting to Cartcam; outcome not public.

market_need_then: YC page cites the claim that consumers are 85 percent more likely to buy after watching a video and says 12 percent of users placed an order; both are company claims.

brand_strength.rationale: No source found showing press, community or recognition around the brand.

outcome_analysis: Cartcam was a one founder Winter 2017 company whose YC status is now Inactive. No shutdown notice, acquisition, post-mortem or funding record was found in searches, so the cause of the inactivity is not public and no failure factor is assigned. The only traction figure is the company's own claim that 12 percent of users ordered through the app.
notes: Website www.cartcam.com did not resolve (dead or blocked). Crunchbase and CB Insights pages were not reachable (403) and a CB Insights hit for CarmaCam is a different company. Outcome, funding, competitor and branding searches returned nothing specific to Cartcam. Competitor list left empty because no source dated near January 2017 was found.
